title: Normalized coordinates for projective-line finite words
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite field extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its recorded valuation ring, a nonnegative integer $n$, and the finite ring $B=\mathcal O_E/\ell^{n+1}$ in the standard small-site module universe. All schemes have the same universe as $E$. For a normalized projective-line tower presentation over S with l invertible, define ProjectiveCoordinates at a finite level to consist of the preceding normalized geometric and tensor coordinates, constant and line coordinates on S, P and W, the specified finite twist transport, positive unit/Chern splitting and named finite invertibility data. Define its recursive push, pull, tensor, constant and line words; define both diagonal identities, composition source units and swapped exchange using the given tower adjunctions. The coefficient towers, normalized section operations, and positive classes use [det-sp-tower-classes] and [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Use [def-sp-p1-coefficient-coordinates]. Use [def-sp-p1-tensor-derived-coordinates]. Use [def-sp-p1-etale-eta-word].
